tells: 1. The laugh barely happens: across six frames the front table only swaps head turns and one raised hand (white-sweater woman); no shoulders, no torso pitch, no open-mouth build, and the purple-top and grey-top women stay identical, so nothing reads as caused by a line (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front table centre)

2. Low-poly neighbours and a smeared face in the close: faceted shoulders on the grey-jacket man and the blonde on the left, whose face is a blurred, featureless mask; the hero's teeth are a flat dark strip (club-4-face.png, left third 0-240 x 120-560; right third 800-1120 x 240-560; centre mouth)

3. The back half of the room is a wall of unlit, identical standing silhouettes behind the tables, a flat cutout layer with no tables, no seats and no motion, which reads as a backdrop, not people (club-1-wide.png, middle band 280-420 y across the full width; club-2-mid.png, upper left 0-560 x 160-320)

4. Bodies sit in tables and chairs: the green-hoodie man's forearms sink into the table top and the white-sweater woman's legs pass through the table base; front-row hands hover above the tabletop (club-1-wide.png, centre tables 580-800 x 470-660; club-6-held.png, centre table 360-660 x 540-640)

5. Uniform CG skin and plastic hair under one warm key: every front face has the same orange tint and no subsurface, hair is helmet-like (pink-tracksuit man, blonde bobs), and the hot backlit sign flares with no matching spill on the heads in front of it (club-3-mid.png, front row 0-1280 x 300-460; club-2-mid.png, sign 180-440 x 130-230)

1. Detached skin-coloured shards float beside the seats: hand or forearm polygons hang in mid-air with no arm attached, beside the blonde, the purple-top woman and others in rows 1-2, and huge ones in the face close (theatre-1-wide.png, 590-610 x 420-470 and 880-910 x 430-480; theatre-3-mid.png, 690-720 x 400-440 and 1100-1130 x 420-470; theatre-4-face.png, 360-410 x 250-420, 80-150 x 410-520, 1030-1100 x 470-570)

2. The second row stands or sits bolt upright in an identical military posture with arms at the sides, like mannequins placed in front of the seats rather than sitting in them; the wide front row sits on the seat edge with knees forward and hands on thighs, all the same pose (theatre-1-wide.png and theatre-6-held.png, rows 330-500 y and 430-700 y)

3. The laugh is not a laugh: one man (teal hoodie) brings his hands up by t=13.0, a few mouths open, and the rest stay still; no collective build or shoulder motion, and the back two-thirds of the house never moves (theatre-5-strip.png, all frames, front two rows vs. everything above)

4. A broken hair or head mesh: a spiky, helmet-like hair shell on the right-end front-row man and the dark-hoodie man reads as a glitched cap; the low-poly faceted chair backs and jacket edges show in the close (theatre-6-held.png, 1040-1090 x 430-470; theatre-2-mid.png, 965-1020 x 300-350; theatre-4-face.png, red seat blocks 1150-1280 x 190-620)

5. The house above row 3 is an unlit field of identical cut-out silhouettes with no seats, no depth cue and no motion, and the dark middle band hides the transition; the stage-spill block of eight lit people in a pitch-black hall reads as a spotlit diorama (theatre-1-wide.png, top half 0-1280 x 100-330; edges 0-270 and 1100-1280)

1. Hair and clothing edges dither into a visible stipple and screen-door pattern, worst on the hero's hair outline in the close and on the cardigan and arm edges at the frame sides (openmic-4-face.png, hair edge 760-880 x 0-340; openmic-6-held.png, right edge 1140-1280 x 420-700 and left edge 0-90 x 480-700)

2. A disembodied hand floats in front of the blonde woman's chest, pale, flat and with no arm, plus a bright blue spark point beside the man at the left (openmic-4-face.png, 1080-1200 x 530-630 and 170-185 x 480-495)

3. Bodies interpenetrate on the crowded bench: the dark-hoodie man's arm passes through the yellow-shirt man's forearm, the green-top woman's shoulder sinks into the brunette's hoodie, and the front row has no visible chairs, so they hover (openmic-6-held.png, 360-420 x 560-620 and 820-900 x 420-560; openmic-1-wide.png, front row 120-1090 x 560-720)

4. The laugh starts well but stays local: the green-top and brunette women turn and lean into each other with open mouths, while the yellow-shirt man and the denim man beside them barely change over a second; the reaction reads as two people chatting, not a room hitting a line (openmic-5-strip.png, frames t=12.6-13.0, centre-left vs. centre-right)

5. Flat, sallow, one-note lighting: every face carries the same yellow-orange key with no rim to separate it from the brown wall, so the back rows merge into mud; a blank flat card (the lit door) and an empty dark ceiling half the frame read as an unfinished set (openmic-1-wide.png, upper half 0-1280 x 0-300 and door 190-250 x 250-350; openmic-3-mid.png, back rows 40-760 x 280-420)
